recommendation: Safe recovery workflow for contractor accounts: 1) Initiate recovery request and capture the contractor’s employee ID. 2) Obtain and document manager confirmation through an authenticated channel. 3) Verify both factors (employee ID + manager confirmation) before executing account recovery. 4) Complete recovery within the 8-hour SLA. 5) As a defense-in-depth improvement, optionally record an independent sponsor confirmation, though the current policy does not require it. 6) Audit and log all steps for compliance review.
quality_notes: Both required verification factors—employee ID and manager confirmation—must be collected and verified before recovery is executed.
All recovery actions should be logged with timestamps to ensure SLA compliance against the 8-hour target.
Independent sponsor confirmation is recommended as an additional safeguard but is not required under the current policy.
Manager confirmation should be obtained via an authenticated channel to prevent social engineering.
